protocol.status: Revised after the initial cliff-only implementation produced zero zones/signals. Added the planned distribution-edge (shelf) crossings of the already specified 20%-of-peak density threshold. No winning/losing trades were available when revising. Chronological holdout is exploratory, not pristine after this feasibility inspection. No performance optimization.
protocol.signalEngine: indicators/ofi.pine executed with PineTS 0.11.1; native TradingView verification outstanding
protocol.instrument: NQ; public archive is NOT established as TradingView NQ1!
protocol.timezone: Raw datetime is UTC per source README; session America/New_York
protocol.profile: Prior complete 390-minute RTH. 2-point rows, uniform candle-range volume allocation. Dense rows >=20% POC; neighboring row either <=35% dense (ledge) OR below 20% POC (distribution/shelf boundary). Rank volume drop, retain <=12 nonoverlapping zones, half-width 2 points.
protocol.failedAuction: Opening 09:30-10:00 range is a deterministic balance proxy when abs(last close-first open)/range <=0.35. Only prior profile zones wholly outside that range qualify. Excursion to zone, reclaim within 3m, later close past rejection candle extreme within 3m. This is a simplified opening-balance failed excursion, not every discretionary FA setup.
protocol.balancedVwap: Prior-close RTH HLC3 volume-weighted VWAP, weighted population SD, 2SD band within 0.25 ATR of prior profile zone. Absolute 10-minute VWAP change / 14-period RTH Wilder ATR <=0.35. Same reclaim and later follow-through.
protocol.signals: Confirmed one-minute closes, 10:00-15:30 NY; one attempted qualifying test per zone per day. Two closes outside zone invalidate; gaps disable rest of session. Both-setup events appear once. Simultaneous candidates use profile-quality order.
protocol.dataRequirements: Score only complete 390-minute RTH dates; engine additionally requires complete prior observed RTH. No invented candles. Full input history retained; no daily resets outside production session rules.
protocol.holdoutPolicy: Fixed chronological split reused from vault. Initial cliff-only baseline emitted no zones/signals over either split. Shelf revision frozen before observing any trade outcomes; later split is exploratory chronological validation, not a pristine untouched holdout. These dates are consumed for OFI after this run.
protocol.entry: Next consecutive RTH minute open after confirmed signal; 1 NQ contract; one position; signals while occupied ignored; no entry after 15:30
protocol.stop: Signal excursion extreme plus 1 point; initial planned risk after entry slippage must be 2 to 60 points inclusive
protocol.target: 2 times initial planned risk from slipped entry, rounded outward to 0.25 tick; fixed comparable trade model, not an intrinsic indicator win rate
protocol.exit: Stop or target, otherwise 60th bar close or 15:59 close; missing-data exits censored, never invented
protocol.ambiguity: Observed open resolves gaps first. If open inside brackets and both touched, stop-first is primary pessimistic assumption; target-first sensitivity also reported. Flag every ambiguous trade.
protocol.winDefinition: Net P&L after modeled commission/slippage > 0; report TP rate separately; zero-net trades are not wins

monteCarlo.method: moving blocks of 5 consecutive scored trading days, sampled with replacement; preserve intraday order and zero-trade days; horizon equals scored split length
monteCarlo.limits: Conditional on this observed sample and cost model; no forecast guarantee, no fabricated price paths, no simple shuffle win-rate claim
